_about: Where each building painting's wall sits, so the front and sides meet at the corners. Fractions of the trimmed picture: wall = left and right wall corners, from the left edge; base, eave, ridge = heights from the bottom edge (base: where the wall meets the ground; eave: the top of the wall; ridge: the top of the roof). For sides, front says which end of the picture is the building's front. eaves = where the front's painted roof ends left and right; the 3D roof copies the front's pitch and overhang, and the sides are cut off at the eave (gable fronts) or re-pitched to meet it (gable sides). chimney = [left, bottom, right, top] of a chimney on a side painting, which becomes a 3D stack above the roof (chimneyOutside: it stands outside the wall). sections = a front that shows two buildings joined (the store): each part's span (to), roof type, ridge, and eaves; rise = meters of 3D roof above the eave, to pitch a low painted roof up so it can be seen from the ground. planks = [left, bottom, right, top] of plain painted wall, used on the 3D walls and gable ends so they match. holes = boxes [left, bottom, right, top] where the dark painted openings are cut out so you can see through (an open porch). clear = polygons [[u, v], ...] made fully see-through (painted roof showing past a neighbor's edge). Check them with: python3 tools/facade_check.py
